privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial orbit is 400km altitude (SMA ~6771.14 km). The target orbit is 800km altitude (SMA ~7171.14 km). The impulsive total delta-V should be approximately 215-220 m/s. The finite burn will result in a higher total delta-V; the gravity_loss_m_s must be the positive difference (finite_total - impulsive_total). The script must be at /home/ga/GMAT_output/gravity_loss_mission.script and the report at /home/ga/GMAT_output/gravity_loss_report.txt.
